tools.name: azure_resources
tools.description: Resources in the subscription, with each one's type, group, location, state and tags, and how many there are of each type.

subscription.description: Default: the one az is set to.

tools.name: azure_vms
tools.description: Virtual machines with whether each is running or deallocated, its size, image, zone and addresses.

tools.name: azure_vm_act
tools.description: Start, stop or restart a virtual machine. Deallocate stops paying for it; powerOff leaves it allocated. Only when the person asked for it.

tools.name: azure_apps
tools.description: App Service and Functions apps with whether each is running, its address, runtime and plan.

tools.name: azure_app
tools.description: One app with its slots, its setting names (never their values) and the addresses it is reached on and calls out from.

tools.name: azure_app_act
tools.description: Start, stop or restart an App Service or Functions app. Only when the person asked for it.

tools.name: azure_storage
tools.description: Storage accounts with their redundancy, access tier and whether anything in them can be read without signing in.

tools.name: azure_activity
tools.description: What has happened to the subscription's resources lately: what was done, by whom, and whether it worked.

tools.name: azure_metrics
tools.description: Azure Monitor numbers for one resource, such as Percentage CPU or Http5xx, over the last few hours.

id.description: The resource id, as the lists give it.

names.description: Metric names, such as Percentage CPU.
